req.title: Reject player creation with invalid id type
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when POST /players/ receives an id that is not an integer.
triggers: reject player creation with invalid id type

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-035 requires HTTP 422 when POST /players/ receives an id field that is not an integer. The PlayerRequestModel uses squad_number (int) as the key integer field; the requirement targets any non-integer id value in the request body. We test: (1) positive — a valid integer squad_number yields 201 (EP, confirms the happy path and that the validator accepts integers); (2) negative — a string value for squad_number yields exactly 422 (EP+NEG, catches status-code mutations); (3) negative — a float string for squad_number yields 422 (NEG, different invalid type); (4) boundary — squad_number as boolean 'true' (JSON) yields 422 because booleans are not valid integers in this context, or if Pydantic coerces it, we verify the exact status; (5) boundary — squad_number as null yields 422 (BVA, null is not an integer); (6) negative — squad_number as an array yields 422 (DT, structural type mismatch). Each test asserts the exact HTTP status code 422 (not >= 400) to kill constant-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_integer_squad_number_returns_201
preconditions: squad_number 99 does not exist in the pre-loaded database
actions: POST /players/ with a fully valid PlayerRequestModel payload where squad_number is an integer (99)
expected: Response body contains the created player with a UUID id field
trace: R-PLAYER-035 — positive path: integer id accepted, confirms validator passes integers through
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_integer_squad_number_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"

test_post_player_valid_integer_squad_number_returns_201()

tests.name: test_post_player_missing_squad_number_returns_422
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number field entirely absent from the payload
expected: Response body contains validation error detail referencing squad_number
trace: R-PLAYER-035 — absent field is the boundary between present-invalid and present-valid; must yield 422
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_missing_squad_number_returns_422():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    fields = [err.get("loc", []) for err in body["detail"]]
    flat_fields = [item for sublist in fields for item in sublist]
    assert "squad_number" in flat_fields or "squadNumber" in flat_fields

test_post_player_missing_squad_number_returns_422()

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app
import json

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_boolean_squad_number_returns_422():
    raw_body = '{"firstName": "Test", "lastName": "Player", "squadNumber": true, "position": "Goalkeeper"}'
    r = client.post(
        "/players/",
        content=raw_body,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body

test_post_player_boolean_squad_number_returns_422()
